_comment: Caption bank. Each caption is used at most once (tracked in workspace/caption_log.json). Keep 0-2 sentences. Add your own; the linter enforces the rules.

statement: Some roads are better at night.
Some tables are set for a reason.
Left it where she'd find it.
Some things are better left unfinished.
Some days don't need a caption. This one almost didn't.
Peace is a choice. So is leaving.
question: Guess.
Where would you go?
You'd recognise it?
Wrong city?
she_line: She said I overthink. She was right.
She doesn't like being in photos.

quote_text._comment: Short lines written ON the image (book/note/phone note), added in post, not generated by the image model. Caption for these posts is usually none or one_word.
self_respect: Respect yourself enough to leave quietly.
Love should feel safe, not small.
Some people miss you. They just don't deserve access to you.
Never chase what already knows where you are.
love: Choose the one who makes peace feel exciting.
Stay where you're understood without explaining.
Real love doesn't need an audience.
dark: Some doors close quietly so you can hear yourself.
Not every disappearance is a goodbye.
You learn the most in the rooms nobody sees.
Regret is just love that arrived late.
discipline: Discipline is remembering what you want.
Say less. Mean all of it.
